# SSL Monitor - RabbitMQ + NGINX Deployment (Autogenerated)

This package contains a deployable Docker Compose setup with:
- Django application (web)
- Celery worker for SSL checks (worker-app)
- Celery worker for email sending (worker-mail)
- RabbitMQ (broker) with management UI
- PostgreSQL (database)
- Redis (cache / result backend)
- NGINX (reverse proxy + static file serving)

## Quick start
1. Copy `.env.template` to `.env` and update passwords.
2. Build and start:
   ```bash
   docker compose up --build -d
   ```
3. Visit app: http://localhost/
   RabbitMQ management: http://localhost:15672 (use credentials from .env)
